end.summary:
Estimated sums by rounding numbers first.
Used estimates to question whether an exact answer was reasonable.
Practised checking subtraction with addition using inverse operations.
Mixed up which subtraction numbers to add when checking; the mix-up remained at the end.
end.parentNote: Kabir practised rounding numbers first and then using the estimate to check whether an answer was reasonable. They correctly estimated several sums and noticed when 5,145 did not fit an estimate near 6,300. Asha modelled carrying while adding, but Kabir still mixed up which numbers to add when checking subtraction, and this was not corrected by the end. At home, use a simple subtraction story and ask: “What part is gone plus what is left?”
